items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Had he ever heard James Reese Europe?

ctx.x: on along with his – they all liked concert music, what we would call pop music now, and the bands.
Had he ever heard James Reese Europe? Do you remember?

I’ve heard of him, but I never had any records on him, that I can remember. Because I got all of his – well, it doesn’t make any difference now, because the basement used to flood when we first moved here 50 years ago. I had all those records downstairs. One day I looked at them. They were under water and warped. I just dried them off and kept them. But they’re not – they’re unplayable. Because I brought his collection here, because he was so crazy about it. I even had his Victrola box, the box that the Victrola…
